quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #20
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does it mean when double solid yellow lines separate traffic lanes?

options.text: You can pass from the left.
You can pass from the right.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot pass from either direction.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Double solid lines mean no passing is allowed from either side.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about existing or possible hazards.
It tells you that a school zone is ahead.
It tells you that a public recreation area is ahead.
It tells you where to find food and gas.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers of hazards. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What should you do if another car is about to hit you?
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you.

questions.question: What are signs called that tell drivers about hazardous conditions?
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell drivers about potential hazards. Follow warning signs to stay safe. Ignoring them can cause accidents.

questions.question: What does a single broken white centerline mean?

options.text: You must stay within your lane.
You can cross it to change lanes.
You can change lanes only from the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can cross it to change lanes.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Broken white lines mean you can pass another vehicle when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: You can pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: By driving on Nebraska roads, have you agreed to a chemical test if asked by a police officer?
questions.explanation: Nebraska has an Implied Consent Law. This means that by driving in the state, you agree to chemical testing if a police officer asks you to take it.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching an accident scene?

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Stop only if you are involved or if emergency help has not arrived.

questions.explanation: Do not stop at an accident unless you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Keep your attention on driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road.

questions.question: When should you check your rearview mirrors?

options.text: Often to see traffic moving behind you.
To see if a vehicle is in your blind spot.
Only when you are slowing down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Often to see traffic moving behind you.
questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors frequently while driving so you know where nearby vehicles are. Do not stare at one spot.

questions.question: Which of the following factors affects how fast a person absorbs alcohol?
questions.explanation: A person's weight affects how fast they absorb alcohol. Other factors include biological sex, how much food is in their stomach, and how many drinks they have had. The only way to remove alcohol from your body is to wait for time to pass.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.

questions.explanation: When it is hard to see because of darkness or bad weather, stay farther behind other vehicles. This gives you more time to stop if a hazard appears suddenly in front of you.

questions.question: This sign shows that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right, then to the left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must go either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must go either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: You are driving on the freeway behind a large truck. You should:

options.text: Follow closely in bad weather because the driver can see farther ahead.
Stay farther back than you would behind a regular car.
Stay one car length behind so the driver can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther back than you would behind a regular car.
questions.explanation: If you follow too closely behind a truck, the truck driver cannot see you in their mirrors. Following too closely is dangerous because you need space to stop if the truck stops suddenly.

questions.question: You hit a parked vehicle and cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to return.
Leave a note with your name and address on the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the vehicle.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked vehicle or damage someone's property, you must leave a note with your name, phone number, and address on the vehicle or property you damaged.

questions.question: A red arrow pointing right on a traffic light means you:

options.text: May turn after slowing down and checking for traffic.
Cannot turn until the light turns green.
May turn after coming to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot turn until the light turns green.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means stop. You must stay stopped until you see a green light or green arrow. Do not turn against a red arrow.

questions.question: The amount of alcohol in the blood is called:
questions.explanation: Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) measures the percentage of alcohol in your blood. A higher BAC means a person is more impaired.

questions.question: Which of the following affect how alcohol impacts a person?

options.text: The amount of food in the stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Eating before or while drinking slows alcohol absorption, but it cannot stop you from becoming impaired if you drink too much.

questions.question: When driving in fog, use your high beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use your low beam headlights when driving in fog. High beams reflect back at you and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What do double solid yellow lane markings mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow lane markings separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Double solid yellow lines mean passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.question: If you stop on the road at night, what should you do?

options.text: Turn on emergency flashers and keep low beams on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on emergency flashers and keep low beams on.
questions.explanation: When stopped on the road at night, turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beam headlights on. This helps other drivers see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what should you never do?

options.text: Look over your shoulder to check blind spots.
Check for other vehicles in the lane.

questions.explanation: Always check mirrors and blind spots for other vehicles before changing lanes. Use your turn signal to warn other drivers. Never change lanes abruptly.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: Turn on your low beam headlights.
Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Do not drive faster than 10 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when visibility is 500 feet or less. High beams reflect off fog and rain, making it harder to see. Low beams help other drivers see you better.

questions.question: Is it illegal to drive beside a motorcycle in the same lane?
questions.explanation: Never share a lane with a motorcycle. Motorcyclists need the full lane width to move safely and avoid hazards.
